description_en: Queries all replication slots of an instance
description_zh: 该接口用于查询实例的所有Replication Slot
name: DescribeSlots

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can call DescribeDBInstances to query the instance ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The resource group ID. This parameter can be left empty
parameters.name: resource_group_id

Slots.description_en: The list of replication slots of the instance

items.description_en: The replication slot of the instance

Database.description_en: The name of the database in which the replication slot resides
Database.description_zh: Replication Slot所在的数据库名称

Plugin.description_en: The plugin used by the replication slot

SlotName.description_en: The name of the replication slot

SlotStatus.description_en:
The status of the replication slot. Valid values:
ACTIVE: Active.
INACTIVE: Inactive
SlotStatus.description_zh:
Replication Slot状态。
ACTIVE：活跃。
INACTIVE：不活跃

SlotType.description_en:
The type of the replication slot. Valid values:
physical: Physical.
logical: Logical
SlotType.description_zh:
Replication Slot类型。
physical：物理。
logical：逻辑

SubReplayLag.description_en: The specific latency of the logical subscription on the subscriber corresponding to the current replication slot. Unit: seconds
SubReplayLag.description_zh: 当前Replication Slot对应订阅端的逻辑订阅的具体延迟，单位为秒（s）

Temporary.description_en:
Indicates whether the replication slot is temporary. Valid values:
true: The replication slot is temporary.
false: The replication slot is not temporary
Temporary.description_zh:
Replication Slot是否为临时性的。
true：是。
false：否

WalDelay.description_en: The amount of logs accumulated by the replication slot
